architecture_summary: Modular React app. Design system components extracted from Stitch screens. Pages map 1:1 to major screens. Shared UI kit in src/components/. Router use React Router. State minimal, local-first. CSS-in-JS via styled-components (already in Stitch output).

tickets.title: Extract design system components from Stitch screens
tickets.description: Parse Stitch HTML/CSS. Build shared UI kit. Components: Button, Badge, Card, Input, Loader/Skeleton, Tab, Table, Toast/Alert. Place in src/components/. Use exact Stitch class names for styling. Keep props minimal. No business logic.
acceptance_criteria: Each component render pixel-perfect match to Stitch screen
Props cover all Stitch variants (size, color, state)

tickets.title: Build main showcase page (src/pages/Showcase.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React. Use design system components. Layout match exact. Responsive breakpoints from Stitch CSS. No hardcoded colors or spacing. Data mock in component for now.

tickets.title: Build feature highlights page (src/pages/Features.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen. Use design system components. Animations match Stitch (CSS transitions only). Data mock in component.

tickets.title: Build 404 error pages (src/pages/errors/*)
tickets.description: Convert all three 404 screens. Use design system components. Randomly rotate between variants on 404 route. Keep Stitch illustrations (SVG inline or img tag).
acceptance_criteria: Each screen pixel-perfect match to Stitch

tickets.title: Build design system showcase pages (src/pages/DesignSystem/*)
tickets.description: Convert all design system showcase screens. Each component get own page. Live interactive demos. Props table auto-generated from component metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Each page pixel-perfect match to Stitch

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create main App shell. Navigation bar match Stitch header. Router use React Router. Routes: / (Showcase), /features, /design-system/*, /404. Lazy load pages. Error boundary wrap all routes. Global styles from Stitch CSS.
acceptance_criteria: Error boundary catch errors, show fallback UI
